All-on-4 landing page

All-on-4, with the price question answered honestly

This is the page the practice does not yet publish as a standalone: one place that explains All-on-4 properly instead of a phone number and a booking link. Same-Day All-On-4 is published on the centre's site from $25,000 per arch, fully inclusive — your final All-on-4 plan and price are confirmed at assessment, after scans and a consultation.

  • A fixed set of teeth supported by implants, planned as one complete restoration rather than tooth by tooth.
  • Same-day provisional teeth where suitable, confirmed at assessment — not promised online.
  • Complex cases, including zygomatic and pterygoid implants, planned with a maxillofacial surgeon in hospital theatre.
  • One consultation funnel: book the $250 consultation (credited if you proceed) and the plan, timeline and price are set out before anything is booked in.
Ask about All-on-4 pricing

Implant & cosmetic treatments

Implants, numbered by the problem they solve

01

Single & same-day implants

One missing tooth, replaced without cutting down the healthy teeth either side — or a full implant placed the same day where suitable. Implants from $6,000. The published figure covers implant surgery, abutment, crown and radiographs; extraction, grafting and same-day provisional work are quoted separately after assessment.

02

All-on-4 full-arch restoration

For a full arch of missing or failing teeth. Same-Day All-On-4 from $25,000 per arch, fully inclusive, as published on the centre's site — the clinic confirms your final plan and price at assessment. See the All-on-4 section above for exactly what the page would cover.

03

Complex implants: zygomatic & pterygoid

For mouths with too little bone for standard implants. Planned with a maxillofacial surgeon, with hospital theatre for the surgical stage — the option for patients told elsewhere that implants were not possible.

04

Smile makeovers, veneers & straightening

Veneers, Invisalign, CEREC crowns and full smile makeovers, planned around how you actually smile, speak and eat. Gum grafting and sedation (nitrous, IV and general) are available, and every plan is priced at assessment.

Same-day implant check

Could same-day implants suit you?

Three quick questions. This is a starting point only — suitability is decided at assessment, not online, and nothing here is a medical verdict.

1. How many teeth are missing?

2. Do you currently wear a denture?

3. Would you like teeth on the same day, if suitable?

Next step: a consultation. Based on your answers, the honest next step is the $250 consultation (credited if you proceed), where scans and an examination confirm whether same-day treatment suits you. Send your answers with the booking form below and the clinic will confirm the plan and price.

The practice

A Pitt Street practice, planned around the patient

Pitt Street Dental Centre sits at Level 2/70 Pitt Street, in the Sydney CBD — a cosmetic and implant practice, not a general clinic that also does implants. Its own pages were last reviewed on August 14, 2026, and its implant work runs on the Straumann premium Swiss system.

Saturday is closed, so the implant funnel runs Monday to Friday — the consultation booking below is the route in, by email or by phone.

Experience, stated two ways — not merged

On the centre's same-day page: Dr Michael Cai has placed 3,000+ implants personally.

On the centre's gum-grafting page: over 7,000 implants and 35,000 crowns placed across his career.

Different scopes, kept separate here exactly as published — one is personal same-day work, the other is a career total.

How treatment proceeds

From first visit to final teeth

1

Consultation

$250, credited back if you proceed. Examination, scans and an honest view of what will and will not work.

2

Plan & price

A written plan for the implant, restoration and any grafting — extraction, grafting and same-day provisional quoted separately after assessment.

3

Treatment

Implant placement, with sedation available (nitrous, IV, general) and hospital theatre for complex surgical stages.

4

Final teeth & care

Crowns, bridge or full-arch teeth fitted, then ongoing cleans and checks to keep them healthy.

Questions patients actually ask

Before you book

What does the from $6,000 implant price cover?

Implant surgery, abutment, crown and radiographs, as stated in the centre's FAQ. Extraction, grafting and same-day provisional work are quoted separately after assessment.

What does Same-Day All-On-4 cost?

Same-Day All-On-4 is published on the centre's site from $25,000 per arch, fully inclusive. Book the consultation and the clinic confirms your final All-on-4 plan and price at assessment.

Is the $250 consultation really credited back?

Yes — the consultation fee is credited back if you proceed with treatment, as published by the centre.

Are you open on Saturdays?

No — Saturday and Sunday are closed. Evening hours run to 8pm on Tuesdays, Thursdays and Fridays, with extended hours by clinician (Dr Katarina Tue/Thu, Dr Mario Thu/Fri).

I am nervous about dental treatment. Can you help?

Sedation is available — nitrous, IV and general — and complex surgical stages can be planned in hospital theatre. Tell the clinic in the booking form.
